brief:
**BLUF:** Freeze warnings are in effect across Tazewell County, VA, and much of the surrounding region through Sunday morning, with lows potentially dropping to freezing or below. In the core area, a school bus accident in Tazewell County and a DUI crash involving a 19-year-old Bluefield woman remain recent developments, alongside ongoing Mercer County school enrollment declines. Regionally, Bridge Day 2026 preparations continue in southern West Virginia with road closures expected, and a planned power outage is set for Pocahontas County, WV.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/15/authorities-seize-over-pound-illicit-cannabis-bluefield/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** No new arrests, charges, or major incidents reported in the last 24 hours from Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, local police departments, or Virginia State Police Division IV. A Tazewell County Public Schools statement addressed a school bus accident (details previously reported around Oct. 12–16).[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/12/two-injured-after-tazewell-county-school-bus-crash/)

A 19-year-old Bluefield woman was charged with DUI after a crash that left a passenger severely injured (reported Oct. 16).[[3]](https://www.bdtonline.com/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours from state police or larger agencies in neighboring counties. A missing woman search continues in Raleigh County, WV (reported Oct. 16).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/16/apb-october-16-2026/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** Freeze Warning issued for Tazewell County, VA (and neighboring counties including Smyth, Bland, Mercer WV), in effect until 9:00 a.m. EDT Sunday, Oct. 18, by NWS Blacksburg. Lows may reach freezing or below.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/15/authorities-seize-over-pound-illicit-cannabis-bluefield/)

**Region:** Freeze Warning issued for multiple WV and KY counties (including McDowell WV, Logan, Mingo, and others) until 9:00 a.m. EDT Sunday, Oct. 18, by NWS Charleston WV. A planned power outage is scheduled in Pocahontas County, WV (reported Oct. 16).[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/15/authorities-seize-over-pound-illicit-cannabis-bluefield/)

Bridge Day 2026 in southern WV will feature 290 registered BASE jumpers with associated road closures and shuttle service (reported Oct. 16).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/16/apb-october-16-2026/)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Mercer County schools continue to face enrollment decline (reported Oct. 17). City of Princeton, WV, announced the 2026 Veterans Day Parade date (reported Oct. 16). Mercer County Commission backed a Pledge of Allegiance project (reported Oct. 16).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/16/apb-october-16-2026/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Nothing new reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours.

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
Freeze warnings expire Sunday morning. Bridge Day 2026 events and road impacts expected in southern WV. Mercer County school enrollment trends and local government meetings may see follow-up coverage. No other scheduled court dates or major developments noted in available sources.
